hero.title: Join us in advancing innovation on Russia’s railways
hero.lead: Design documentation development to support technological sovereignty

culture.title: You’ll thrive here if you:
bullets: Enjoy working in a collaborative team where your voice matters and you respect colleagues’ viewpoints
Can work in an atmosphere of trust, without constant oversight, and understand the importance of your work
Want to engineer some of Russia’s most forward-looking railway technologies

items.title: Private healthcare (DMS)
items.body: A voluntary medical programme with emergency home visits, dentistry, outpatient care, and more. Coverage kicks in once probation finishes.

items.title: Flexible hours
items.body: Flexible start and end times, plus one remote working day after the probation period.

items.title: Training & conferences
items.body: Sponsored coursework and attendance at specialist conferences aligned with your role.

items.title: Employee benefits bundle
items.body: Monthly commuting allowance plus financial support tied to statutory annual leave (from two years at the company onward) alongside other perk programmes.

items.title: Corporate sports
items.body: Volleyball and badminton activities with colleagues.

items.title: Accredited IT employer
items.body: ECRT is listed in Russia’s accredited IT roster, unlocking nationwide support measures for peers in the tech sector.
